ai_content.desc_en: Ramy, the son of Egyptian immigrants, navigates a spiritually conflicting journey in his New Jersey neighborhood. He is pulled between his Muslim community that thinks life is a constant test, his millennial friends who think life is full of endless possibilities, and a God who's always watching. Ramy experiences a unique journey in this neighborhood, where he encounters different cultures and conflicting perspectives. Ultimately, he finds himself expressing his emotions and life experiences.
